description: Return a list of all Configurable Field Sets associated with a Company.

parameters.name: filters[type][]
parameters.description: Filter by field set type(s). Could be a string or an array of string.

parameters.name: filters[generic_tool_id][]
parameters.description: Filter by generic tool id(s). Could be a integer or an array of integer.

items.description: Generic tool IDs that are associated to the Configurable Field Set

parameters.name: filters[incident_type_id][]
parameters.description: Filter by incident type id(s). Could be an integer or an array of integers.

items.description: Incident type IDs associated to the Configurable Field Set

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specify which view to render. Options are common, extended, mobile, or with_project_ids

id.description: The unique identifier of the configurable field set.

name.description: The name of the configurable field set.

type.description: The type of configurable field set

category.description: Specifies the category for the configurable field set if it exists or an empty string. This property was added for the ConfigurableFieldSet::Observations::Item class.

class_name.description: Specifies the class the configurable field set is associated with.

fields.description: Specifies the hash of fields on an object. This is for example purposes only.

sections.description: An array of sections that are used for custom fields.

inspection_type_id.description: The unique identifier of the inspection type.

incident_type_id.description: The unique identifier of the incident type.

generic_tool_id.description: The unique idenfitier of the generic tool.

action_plan_type_id.description: The unique idenfitier of the action plan type.

observations_category_id.description: The unique identifier of the observations category.

has_custom_fields.description: Indicates whether the configurable field set has any custom fields defined.

has_custom_fields_sections.description: Indicates whether the configurable field set has custom fields organized into sections.
